title: Forward step of the copying machine
statement: Let $M$ be the copying machine, with distinct source and destination tape indices $s$ and $d$. Suppose a word $w$ is stored on the source tape of a configuration $c$: at every offset $p$ from $-1$ through $|w|$, the cell at the source head position plus $p$ agrees with the word buffer at offset $p$. If $r<|w|$, then one step of the copying machine from its prescribed forward configuration at progress $r$ gives the forward configuration at progress $r+1$.
hypotheses_covered: Source tape agrees with the buffer for every offset $-1\le p\le |w|$
